note: SPEC-PROTO-0002 §5.1, §7.1, §10.1, PV7, PV15; ADR-0067. Fake person data. The enc_private_jwk values are fixed TEST keys derived from public seeds (SHA-256 of 'tamga-conformance/openid4vp/<label>'); they exist only so that the encrypted responses can be opened and are never used by a real system. No other private key. Fixed: keys, time, state, nonce, branch ids, the wallet's JWE ephemeral key and IV. Varies per generation: issuer signature, disclosure salts, KB-JWT signature.

kb_aud.rule: cross_device: KB-JWT aud = client_id (full, with prefix); dc_api: KB-JWT aud = 'origin:' + page origin, also with a signed request (OpenID4VP 1.0 Annex A.4). A verifier given an origin and a different aud rejects at A1.
kb_aud.trust: minimal trust source: freshness healthy, no records (A steps only; B2 follows)

cases.name: cross-device (signed request / QR): KB-JWT aud = client identifier → passes
cross-device: KB-JWT aud = origin:<origin> (DC API binding on the QR path) → A6
cross-device: verifier passes neither aud nor origin → A1
DC API: KB-JWT aud = origin:<origin>, verifier passes origin only (aud derived) → passes
DC API: verifier passes origin and aud = origin:<origin> → passes
DC API: KB-JWT aud = client identifier (cross-device binding on the DC API path) → A6
DC API: KB-JWT aud = origin of another site → A6
DC API: verifier misconfigured with aud = client identifier → A1 (explicit, not a generic A6)

wallet_decline.note: wallet-core declineRequest: plaintext form to response_uri with only error=access_denied and state (PV5); no POST on the DC API path

scenarios.name: single fetch: plaintext decline closes the only branch → presentation REJECTED
single fetch: encrypted decline is handled like the plaintext one
two fetches: a decline closes only its own branch (soft decline); the other branch completes

scenarios.name: two fetches: encrypted decline on b2, then b1 completes
state of another branch: decrypted but counted as an attempt on the receiving branch only
responses that no branch key opens do not touch the presentation and are not attempts (RQ4, RQ6)

plaintext decline with an unknown state
plaintext decline with the DC API state
encrypted decline on the DC API key
